title: CuraSphere product charter
source: Phase 00 of the CuraSphere Engineering Specification Pack v1.0, as reproduced in the phase specification. The source docx is not present in this checkout.

customers.description: A healthcare provider organization that operates one or more facilities and needs a governed clinical record.

customerExclusions: An individual consumer buying a diagnosis or a treatment recommendation.
A payer, clearinghouse, or device vendor as the system of record for this charter.

jurisdictions.statement: No production jurisdiction is selected. Synthetic demonstration tenants are not markets and are not approval to operate.

personas.description: An administrator of one provider organization.
An auditor of one provider organization.
The person whose record is being read.

valuePropositions: The clinical source record stays authoritative. Derived views cite it and do not replace it.
A clinician remains in control of consequential clinical actions.
Tenant, facility, and purpose of use are derived on the server.
exclusions: A claim of certification, device authorization, or clinical validation from this repository or from synthetic data.
Real patient information in fixtures, or a live payment.
nonGoals: Replacing the clinician with generated text.
Letting a derived artifact silently change a source fact.
Depending on one model vendor for a core workflow.

successTargets.measure: A release is not accepted unless a chart write stores an audit row for the actor the server derived.
A release is not accepted unless a model call that would generate clinical text is refused while its intended use is still pending.
A release is not accepted unless a user in one tenant cannot read another tenant's patient row.

capabilities.name: Core healthcare system of record
capabilities.intendedUse: Record and read the facility source chart.

capabilities.name: Clinical decision support
capabilities.intendedUse: Show derived lines that cite stored source facts. A person decides any consequential action.

capabilities.name: Patient engagement
capabilities.intendedUse: Show that person their own stored record and accept a message into the record.

capabilities.name: Operations intelligence
capabilities.intendedUse: Show counts of stored operational facts for one organization.

capabilities.name: Financial and claims intelligence
capabilities.intendedUse: Record administrative amounts. A stored amount is not a charge.

capabilities.name: Research and population health
capabilities.intendedUse: Count de-identified groups. A small group is omitted.

capabilities.name: Regulated medical AI modules
capabilities.intendedUse: No module in this charter is cleared for diagnosis or treatment. Classification stays pending.

capabilities.name: Platform and marketplace
capabilities.intendedUse: Administer listings and release holds. An extension is not installed by this charter.

approvalHistory.note: Draft state preserved when the charter was approved.

approvalHistory.statement: Reviewed and accepted the product vision, intended users, intended-use classifications, scope, market boundaries and governing principles.
